changes.change: Fixed an issue where the canvas never got cleared, if the now playing application has been changed without killing Spotify
Fixed some alignment issues for the images in the PreferenceBundle for bigger devices
Added a new option in preferences for transitions between changes of artworks or canvases
Added Support for newer Spotify Versions (9.1.24+)
Fixed some issues in the PreferenceBundle
Fixed a issue, where the Device need a Respring after a update for Spotify
Refactored the whole codebase for better code quality
Refactored everything to support all Spotify Versions since 9.0.0+
Fixed an issue where Spotify would crash on versions newer than 9.0.66
Fixed a bug that prevented Canvases from being downloaded when the song also had a video
Added Support for newer Spotify Versions (9.0.40+)
Added an option for AOD (Always-On Display)
Fixed a bug where the tweak would not function if the official Spotify app was not installed
